تواءيت (form VI)

# تَوَاءَيْتَ (tawāʔayta) /ta.waː.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاءَى (tawāʔā)
# تَوَاءَيْتِ (tawāʔayti) /ta.waː.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاءَى (tawāʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
